shots.caption: N305DK's 17 Nov run from Gray AAF down I-5 to Olympia, in 3D at true altitude, with the Orbit control turning the camera.
shots.alt: A 3D view of a real Smokey flight path draped over terrain, the camera orbiting slowly while the rotate, tilt, compass and Orbit buttons sit at the top right.

shots.caption: History mode on a phone: open HISTORY, pick Last 30 days, and a month of Smokey routes draws in. Then zoom to the Sound.
shots.alt: On a phone, the radar's History sheet opens, Last 30 days is picked, and thirty days of Smokey flight paths fill in across the Puget Sound map.

shots.caption: Ember, Magma, Ice. Each palette recolours the heat, the routes and the roads under them.
shots.alt: The desktop radar with its layers panel open, switching the map palette from Ember to Magma to Ice, the heat and the tinted motorways changing colour each time.

shots.caption: Command-K from anywhere. Type a tail, hit Enter, land on its logbook.
shots.alt: On desktop with the sidebar showing, the search palette opens, N305DK is typed, and Enter lands on that plane's page.

shots.caption: The Now tab on a phone. One glance: up, down, or the feed's quiet.
shots.alt: SmokySignal's home screen on a phone, showing the live status of the Smokey fleet.

shots.caption: Desktop gets the sidebar: every page, six sections, one rail.
shots.alt: SmokySignal's home screen on desktop with the navigation sidebar down the left.

shots.caption: What's circling: anything working a pattern right now, in plain words.
shots.alt: The What's circling page on a phone.

shots.caption: What flew over Fife on 17 Nov around 15:30: N305DK, right overhead at 15:22, 1,600 ft, working I-5.
shots.alt: The /seen answer for Fife on 17 November at 15:30: N305DK, Smokey 4, passed 0.1 mi away at 15:22 at 1,600 ft, with a small map of its pattern over I-5.

shots.caption: I-5's pass history: time overhead, the busiest stretch and the hour of day.
shots.alt: The I-5 road history page on a phone with time overhead and the busiest stretch.

shots.caption: The forecast's month view: hour by weekday for November so far. History, not a promise.
shots.alt: The forecast month view on desktop, an hour-by-weekday grid of Smokey activity for November 2026.

shots.caption: Stats keeps a permanent daily log of hours aloft, week by week.
shots.alt: The stats page on desktop with hours aloft by week.

shots.caption: N305DK's logbook: sorties and hours per month, departure fields, time on station.
shots.alt: N305DK's page on a phone, scrolled to its logbook.

shots.caption: Every flight renders a share card: the track, the altitude profile and the corridor it worked.
shots.alt: The share card for N305DK's 18 November flight, with the track, an altitude profile and the corridor it worked.

shots.caption: The shop board, a departures board for the TV over the bench.
shots.alt: The /board departures-board view on a desktop screen.

shots.caption: Handlebar mode: huge type, high contrast, screen kept awake.
shots.alt: The /glance handlebar view on a phone, status in very large type.

shots.caption: The speed warning, illustrative: a staged rider and a staged bird. Opt in, foreground only, and your speed never leaves the phone.
shots.alt: The full-screen EASE OFF speed warning on a phone, with the distance to the bird and how far over the limit the rider is.

shots.caption: All aircraft: every tail we watch, grouped by mission, with where the facts came from.
shots.alt: The All aircraft page on desktop, tails grouped by mission with their sources.
